messages:
Maya R: Quick heads-up — we are opening a developer preview for 'Hosted Lite' next Tues. Hosted Lite is an optimized hosted endpoint for small/medium models with lower cost-per-token and tighter p99 latency for short chats. Preview will include streaming + tool-calling support, mobile-friendly SDKs, and a migration guide. :tada:

Maya R: Preview access will be gated (apply via the form in the doc) and we plan canary keys + region-limited rollout for the first two weeks. Expect GA planning after feedback from the preview cohorts.

Alex K: Nice! Is this a new model family or runtime config?

Maya R: It’s a runtime profile + curated model variants. Same Hosted API surface (POST /v1/generate and /v1/chat), but with different default batching/quantization configs to favor latency and cost. SDKs will auto-select the profile when you pick the `hosted-lite` model alias.

Samir P: Any breaking changes for tool-calling? We rely on function routing and structured output.

Maya R: No breaking changes. Tool-calling is supported. Small caveat: in preview some advanced function hooking (edge tool proxies) will be opt-in — we want to validate latencies before enabling for all tenants. Document shows opt-in flag and quick example.

Liz C: Can you drop a sample curl for the preview endpoint?

Maya R: Sure — example (internal preview domain):

```
curl -X POST https://preview-hosted-lite.redwood.internal/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer PREVIEW-KEY-XXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this in 2 bullets"}], "model":"hosted-lite-1","stream":true}'
```

Maya R: Please don't share preview keys outside Redwood. Security review completed this morning; product + security agree on default telemetry and KMS handling.

eng-oncall: Noted — SLO/alerting will need a new p99 target. Can you confirm expected p99 for 32-token responses in us-east-1?

Maya R: Target p99 ~ 120ms for 32-token median workloads in us-east-1 under normal load. We'll publish perf profiles in the doc. If ops sees regressions during canary, we’ll roll back the profile to the standard hosted runtime.

Alex K: How to opt into the preview for a customer? I assume a single preview API key per org?

Maya R: Correct — we’ll generate a per-org canary key and attach metadata (region, start/end dates). There’s a small quota by default; ops can request increases via the canary form.

Samir P: Rollout plan? Any on-call windows we should know about?

Maya R: Plan is:
- Tue 09:00 UTC: Enable preview domain and issue first batch of keys.
- Tue 09:30 UTC: Start small traffic canary (5 orgs). ProductBot will announce canary and track results.
- Wed-Fri: Expand to 50 orgs and gather telemetry + prompt-quality feedback.
- Following Mon: Review and decide GA cadence.

ProductBot: Scheduled canary run created for 2475004800 (Tue 09:30 UTC). Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/hosted-lite-preview

Liz C: Heads-up for docs team — need migration guide + code samples for JS/py. I can help author.

Maya R: Thanks — assigning docs pairing with Liz. Also adding a short checklist for SDK maintainers: update model alias mapping, ensure streaming examples use chunked framing, validate tool-calling hooks.

Alex K: Any billing changes users should expect?

Maya R: Preview will be free credit for participants. Billing model for GA: lower per-token price but a small per-request surcharge for extremely low-latency mode. We'll finalize after preview.

Samir P: If we hit perf regressions, what's the fallback? Automatic fallback to standard hosted runtime?

Maya R: Yes — requests have a failover policy. If latency > threshold or errors spike, router will fall back to the compatible standard model variant. We’ll surface anomalies in the rollout dashboard.

Liz C: Signing up now. Form link?

Maya R: https://intranet.redwood.ai/forms/hosted-lite-preview-signup — fill org name, region, expected qps, and contact.

Alex K: Thanks Maya. :rocket:

Samir P: 👀 will monitor canary metrics from my side, ping me if you want an on-call hand during the first hour.

Maya R: Appreciate it — ping @eng-oncall the morning of the rollout for the handover.

ProductBot: Reaction summary: :tada: x3, :eyes: x2, :rocket: x1
